rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-3: ONE knob per-scan lr 1e-3->1e-4 (n_iter reset 600->300). Failure mode: per-scan U-Net N2I has no early-stop, so each val scan overfits its own GT-free split-view objective. iter-1 (n_iter300)=0.9553, iter-2 (n_iter600)=0.9407 DROPPED -> more per-scan steps hurt, n_iter is NOT the lever. Lower lr anchors the per-scan fit near the warm-start init (the proven sibling fix: demo_dl n2i lr1e-3->1e-4 lifted 0.4785->0.4880; Mayo n2i testing lr3e-4). Hypothesis: lr1e-4 keeps each scan near its warm-start init, lifting SSIM/PSNR toward/above the 39.68dB LD-FBP baseline and breaking the 0.9553 plateau.
